test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: S,T, U, V, W, X, Y and Z were eight ministers, sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. They were equidistant to one another. Only V was sitting between S and X. Only T was sitting between Z and W. Y was sitting fourth to the left of W, while S was sitting fourth to the left of T. Z was sitting second to the left of Y. Which minister was sitting fourth to the left of X?
solution:
**Given: **S,T, U, V, W, X, Y and Z were eight ministers, sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

(1) Only V was sitting between S and X. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ca8793bc4c78aa8e0e01f07e313e35b2cefe446db4a04222854c95b313c2260.png] 

(2) S was sitting fourth to the left of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32a75f52d37f49f355011904cfe0fc7bc60df5db5d2a82afee59f9c50b3a30b5.png] 

(3) Only T was sitting between Z and W. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd73e9b92629b8c8ed9bf3c7e7cecec87d42000ab48926fc021489f686ce9738.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea4f0975826a463d5e84f2843b36fbc33ad999fefdc559816165fd20e541e121.png] 

 

(4) Y was sitting fourth to the left of W.

 
• It is possible Only in Case 1(b) and Case 2(a). 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/537f877980061c41a29d3ec710a3c6921717d70117e910624ef71617d1e17541.png] 

(5) Z was sitting second to the left of Y.

 
• It is possible only in Case 2(a).

(6) U will sit on unoccupied seat. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e49726765e2f8fbd66f569035d7a89f36008d7eeb6a0c6d060562ed2b0fdd3a.png] 

Here, U was sitting fourth to the left of X.

Hence, '**option 1'** is the correct answer.
